This file is a notebook-optimized projection of the public Ω object universe. The Notebook is a bounded cognitive/research cell, not the Station, operator, canon, database, or truth authority.

## Notebook contract

```text
NOTEBOOK != STATION
NOTEBOOK_CHAT != CANONICAL_MEMORY
CROSS_NOTEBOOK_MEMORY != ASSUMED
SOURCE_ATTACHMENT != AUTHORITY_PROMOTION
PLATFORM_PROFILE != CANON_FORK
CLAIM != EVIDENCE
FORMAL_PROOF != EMPIRICAL_CONFIRMATION
```

Use visible Drive-backed artifacts or explicit BridgeCapsules for continuity. Do not rely on invisible cross-notebook state.

## Notebook operating pattern

```text
READ SHARED PUBLIC SOURCES
-> IDENTIFY NOTEBOOK ROLE
-> BUILD LOCAL WORKING CONTEXT
-> RESEARCH / DERIVE / SYNTHESIZE
-> EXPOSE SOURCES + UNCERTAINTY
-> EMIT VISIBLE BRIDGECAPSULE
-> RETURN TO CANONICAL WORKFLOW
```

Notebook-specific source attachment and UI behavior may differ from ChatGPT/Codex. The semantic parent may not.
